category_budget_rate_check.name: category_budget_rate_check
category_budget_rate_check.value: ("category_budget"."account_id" IS NULL) = ("category_budget"."exchange_rate" IS NULL) AND ("category_budget"."exchange_rate" IS NULL OR "category_budget"."exchange_rate" > 0)

journal_entry_split_check.name: journal_entry_split_check
journal_entry_split_check.value: ("journal_entry"."split_id" IS NOT NULL OR NOT "journal_entry"."split_remainder") AND ("journal_entry"."split_id" IS NULL OR ("journal_entry"."transfer_id" IS NULL AND "journal_entry"."compensation_id" IS NULL))

loan_event_kind_check.name: loan_event_kind_check
loan_event_kind_check.value: ("loan_event"."kind" <> 'drawdown' OR "loan_event"."amount" IS NOT NULL) AND ("loan_event"."kind" NOT IN ('buyback', 'insurance') OR "loan_event"."amount" IS NULL) AND (("loan_event"."kind" = 'insurance') = ("loan_event"."insurance_mode" IS NOT NULL AND "loan_event"."insurance_rate" IS NOT NULL))
